title: Batch dosing with a dose counter
nl_spec: A dosing station counts discrete doses. Each rising edge of Trigger (a dose-complete pulse) increments an internal dose Count, up to the batch target N = 3; the count must never exceed N. When Count reaches N, assert Done. A Reset input clears the count back to 0 (and Done clears). Use an internal INT Count (0..N) and an internal BOOL PrevTrigger for edge detection. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named dosing with inputs Trigger, Reset and output Done.

safety_properties.nl: The dose count never exceeds the target (no over-dosing).
Done is asserted only when the target has been reached.

notes: Counter via guarded INT increment (Count < N), edge-detected on Trigger; tests bounded arithmetic in the verifier.
